programme.desc: Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: There are so many things that can kill you in the Amazon. The guys rent a boat as protection and head down river to explore the rainforest. They find poisonous insects, angry snakes, and natives living in hand-built huts. After getting stuck in a 70 meter high tree in an Amazonian thunderstorm, and attacked by vicious pink dolphins, they hop on a plane headed for the island of Fernando de Noronha. Here they try their hand at scuba diving and witness the hatching of close to 1000 baby sea turtles. The dynamic changes when Justin and Gisele know their time together will soon be ending.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Avoiding the resorts and the all-inclusive vacation, Scott and Justin rent a car and head towards the tobacco fields around Viñales. They’re looking for a specific farmer to return a picture to him from a friend who visited years ago. After the successful search and a visit into the farmer’s home, they grab a couple of horses to ride into the countryside and try some sugarcane rum. On their way to Trinidad they pick up a hitchhiker, play a game of baseball with some kids, and are invited to take part in a traditional Santeria ceremony. But even the swinging machete, beating drums, sacrificed chicken, rum and cigars won’t end this trip. The three drive along the south east coast and visit Fidel Castro’s remote hideout on their way to Carnival in Santiago de Cuba.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: After being separated at the airport and put on different flights, Scott arrives to find that his bag has gone missing. The guys grab supplies and climb into an old soviet van to start a long trek out to a Nomadic Reindeer tribe. But to get there, they will have to travel by van then by horseback for four days. Scott and Justin take part in the tribe’s traditional way of life and come to understand the necessity of the nature and balance around them.

programme.title: Alan Cummings: Paradise Homes
programme.desc: On a journey back to his rugged roots of the Scottish Highlands, Alan experiences an extraordinary hidden getaway living in harmony with ancient land, complete with 360 views and golden eagles circling the property. In Sicily, Alan tours an eccentric family home built above a cave, filled with innovative and intricate space-saving details, including a one-of-a-kind bedroom climbing wall!

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Iceland’s raw nature, good hearted people and vast open spaces encourage Scott and Justin to brave the elements. From Reykajavik the guys rent a 4x4 truck and hit the open roads, no matter what the conditions. They encounter a family while sheep herding, and join in to help on their way to find adventure in the ice and glaciers . Active volcanoes, ice climbing and squeezing into an underground lava tube hint towards some of the personal strength needed to continue their world adventures.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Scott and Justin ultimately find themselves in the midst of some of the most wild roads and dangerous animals on the planet. Sleeping in a tree-blind while lions walk directly under them or taking a walking safari is no match to the real situation with the people they meet. The guys experience a way of life that is so drastically different than theirs, impoverished and battling the HIV/AIDS epidemic, the guys witness the joy and sorrow at a small church ceremony and gain a fresh outlook from their new Zambian friends.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: In order to meet the King in the village of Vohipeno, Scott and Justin have to take a long train ride through the rainforest and bring gifts for the kingdom. Along with a Rooster and Rabbit aptly named “Pancakes” and “Waffles”, they make their way through Madagascar where they find lemurs, climb the jagged cliffs in Tsingy and develop friendships with a village full of chanting kids.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Despite Justin's difficulties with altitude sickness in India, they make their way up to 15,000 feet in the Altiplano of northern Chile. Justin gets sick and requires a hospital visit and oxygen. Beat down, he tries again, this time in the adventure mecca of San Pedro by biking down a mountain. They sleep in tents amongst the beautiful landscapes of active volcanoes, salt flats and pink flamingo reserves before heading to the mystical island of Chiloe. Here they experience life as it was one hundred years ago, and meet strange and wonderful characters, including the moonshine-making Grandma Rosa and the mythological Filiberto, who gives Justin and Scott advice that may change their lives.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: History repeats itself as Scott and Justin push as far south as they can go. Adventure, fate, chance and the infestation of the travel bug all play a huge role. On one of the most remote islands on Earth, Easter Island, the guys experience the breath-taking awe of the infamous heads and try scuba diving again. They then head to Patagonia to help with Gaucho sheep-sheering and to visit a penguin island where a brave little penguin develops a crush on Scott. Their experiences in the southern-most town on Earth ultimately wins them a ticket to Antarctica, when by chance they run into a pilot friend who took them on an Arctic cargo plane one year previously.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: The crew are headed to a place they never thought they would ever see in their lifetime - Antarctica. Claimed by some, owned by no one. A continent for peace and science, the betterment of all mankind. Scott and Justin are granted a rare opportunity to stay in the Chilean scientific base on King George Island. They spend a week learning about life on the continent, while visiting the nearby Russian and China bases, all perfect microcosms of their home countries. The three then get on a Russian expedition ship and head down the Antarctic peninsula to witness some of the world’s most breathtaking and serene atmospheres imaginable. They discover all the wonderful flora and fauna of Antarctica, and end it all by claiming a little piece of Antarctica for themselves in Paradise Bay, and building a snowman to guard their claim.

Following the Allied victory, the United States moved the local inhabitants from their quiet paradise in order to conduct atomic bomb testing at the famous Bikini Atoll. Ellis explores how, almost 65 years later, both the people and environment continue to be affected.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: One newcomer gets a forceful yet thorough tour of the arena hazards in the eliminators. Flippers prove to be this heats weapon of choice and they are put to great effect, as many robots take to the air.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The Extreme series returns to its normal format after the first Annihilator. Four mixed battles, followed by a Main Event, which in this episode is an All-Stars battle between Pussycat and Stinger.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Shunt and Dead Metal prepare to be let loose from the sidelines in this episodes Main Event, House Robot Rebellion. Three unfortunate competitors will be put into the arena as the House Robots have free reign in this destructive episode.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: We have reached the Quarter Finals for the All-Stars battles in this episode’s Main Event and another Mayhem battle puts another three robots up against each other.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Four of the best robots armed with rear-hinged flippers go against each other to prove whose best in Flipper Frenzy. Other battles on the card are the Challenge Belt, Tag Team Terror, Wild Card Warriors and Mayhem battle.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Current World Champions Razer are matched against fierce competitor Firestorm in this All-stars match. Four robots make their way to the arena to take part in the German Melee, with the winner securing a place in the Second World Championship.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The Featherweight Championship takes place in this episode, along with the Challenge Belt, Mayhem battle and more Wildcard Warriors. All these build-up to the Main event, the Tag Team Terror finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The second annihilator was supposed to be between the six winners of the mayhem qualifiers, but due to the severity of damage from the battle, two of the robots had to be replaced. Will the two replacements seize this opportunity?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The UK are up against renowned German Engineering in a UK vs Germany battle. Two more rivals have a chance to settle the score in another vengeance battle and other unmissable battles take place before the long awaited All-Stars Grand Final.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Robots from around the globe ready themselves for the ultimate contest, The Second World Championship. Will lightning strike twice for defending champions Razer, or will they reign be snuffed out by one of the many fierce competitors?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Six teams comprised of armed and emergency services enter their robots for battle, will their unpredictable and dangerous occupations prepare them for the carnage of the arena or will the house robots make them quake in their boots?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The first heat of the Fifth Wars raises the bar for action. With newcomers outnumbering the veterans, will and underdog manage to secure a place in the finals?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: One newcomer gets a forceful yet thorough tour of the arena hazards in the eliminators. Flippers prove to be this heats weapon of choice and they are put to great effect, as many robots take to the air.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The eliminators continue as more newcomers and veterans enter the arena, ready to destroy each other for the spot in the finals. One competitor’s design renders their adversary’s weapon useless, can they adapt, or will they be wiped out?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: More flipping action as we witness one of the quickest immobilisations in Robot Wars history. A house robot gets a little too eager when trying to pit a competitor.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: More hopefuls enter the arena, as they risk life and limb for a chance at the finals. An equally matched battle leaves the decisions to the judges, and two house robots work together to inflict some last minute damage.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Halfway through the heats and the competition is on fire, literally. The arena is out for revenge after another competitor inadvertently vandalises it. One robot commits the ultimate sin, attacking the benevolent Refbot.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The house robots venture into the funeral business as they hold cremations and burials in the Robot Wars arena, to the applause of a live audience. One flip may spell doom early on for one competitor.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: One competitor achieves every flipper robot’s dream in this episode’s heats, rapidly ending the first round. Another robot refuses to go into the pit alone and takes down whoever they can get grip on.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: One competitor gets chopped up by competitor and house robot alike and a quick eviction from the arena makes the judge’s job a simple one. A seemingly one-sided fight takes a different direction, thanks to the hazardous arena.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: When the competitor’s weapons aren’t quite doing the job, they must resort to using the arena to secure the win. There’s not enough room for the both of them, which robot from the Isle of Sheppey will prove itself the best in this chance encounter.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: World Champions meet a newcomer in this episode’s heat, will it be an easy appetiser, or a major upset? One uneventful round leaves the house robots responsible for entertaining the crowd.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The last heats of the fifth series. Matilda breaks the rules and strays from her zone, inflicting massive damage on unsuspecting robots, much to the dismay of the judges.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The semi-finals are here and the competitors step up a notch, even the house robots need to be cautious. One of the three losers of the first rounds have an opportunity for redemption in the Losers Melee.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: After this episode, the Grand Final lineup will be decided. With pressure mounting the robots are going all out. One competitor is sent to the clouds with the help of another. The house robots help decide who makes it to through.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: This episode, Robot Wars: The Fifth Wars will have a champion. As the proven best robots of the series gather one last time, the competition has never been more evenly matched.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The first heat of the All-Stars Championship, this heat determines which two robots go through to All-stars grand-final. Veteran robots all enter the arena once again as they put their experience to the test against each other.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Six more renowned robots fight their way through the heats to fight for a chance to be the All-Star champion. One competitor in particular strikes fear into the roster. The two winners of each heat face off for the title in the Grand Final.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The Extreme Series continues with the Annihilator; a knockout competition between six competitors, over the course of four rounds and a final, six will be reduced to one, the annihilator champion.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Using competitors own video diaries, exclusive action from the pits and the best of the battles, Philippa Forrester will get down to the nuts and bolts of Robot Wars, The Second Wars.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Philippa goes behind the scenes to find out how the shows fighting machines are made, whilst uncovering the trials and tribulations of their frantic creators.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Another visit behind the scenes of Robot Wars Series 2, more exclusive footage and access to the pits shows every nook and cranny of this week’s competitors.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Witness hope, triumph, desperation and defeat as Philippa takes us back to the pits, where competitors make final touches to their Robots, hoping they come back in one piece.

programme.title: The Dream Children
programme.desc: Alex wants to become a father. Steven, his partner, has to confront his insecurities and fear of change after a lifetime smothered by superficiality. Unable to adopt legally, but still eager to become parents, they decide to turn to the black market, adopting a child from a desperate young woman, who's return with a dangerous new boyfriend, threatens to destroy everything they love.

programme.title: Animals
programme.desc: A sexually confused teen finds solace with his wise-cracking pet bear but everything changes when he falls in love.

programme.title: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: A Brother in the Catholic Church must choose between his vow of chastity and the man he loves.

programme.title: Cherry Grove Stories
programme.desc: CHERRY GROVE STORIES recounts the unique character of Cherry Grove, a community on Fire Island, New York.

programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.title: GINTAMA [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In an era where aliens have invaded and conquered feudal Tokyo, a young samurai seeks work as he can.

programme.title: The Villainess [English Dub]
programme.desc: An assassin seeks revenge after secrets ruin her chance at freedom, unleashing her deadly skills in a bloody rampage.

programme.title: SPECIAL ID [English Dub]
programme.desc: A cop goes undercover in a ruthless underworld organization to stop a gang leader, only to put himself in great danger after being exposed by his former protégé and best friend.

programme.title: The Isle [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: There is a fishing resort remote from the world. The owner, Hee-jin, drops by floating houses and serves the customers: by selling them food, necessities, and sex. One day, a new customer arrives: Hyun-suk is a former detective who killed his cheating girlfriend. Hee-jin feels a bond with him and keeps watching him. That night, he tries to shoot himself, but she stops him. As some incidents happen, she develops an obsession with him. And he also finds it difficult to leave the fishing resort and her.

programme.title: The Informant [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Detective O Nam-hyeok, a spectacularly inept cop clinging to his badge by a thread. When a botched sting operation lands him in hot water, he's forced to partner with Cho Tae-bong, a razor-sharp informant whose cover and savings are blown by Nam-hyeok's bumbling. With a smuggling ring to bust and zero trust between them, this mismatched duo must navigate double-crosses, bruised egos, and their own chaotic partnership while taking down a criminal organization.

programme.title: Chongqing Hot Pot [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Three money-strapped friends accidentally dig themselves into a bank vault ripe for robbing in this visually stunning crime-comedy.

programme.title: Sea Fog [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Written and produced by Bong Joon-ho (PARASITE, SNOWPIERCER, THE HOST), SEA FOG is a maritime thriller that captures the essence of why he is considered on of the most talented filmmakers working today. Upon learning that his decaying fishing trawler, the Junjin, is about to be sold, Captain Kang looks to make one final score by smuggling illegal immigrants from China to South Korea. After arriving at the agreed pickup point, a violent storm forces the Junjin to stall in open waters. As tension and unrest spread, Kang and his five-man crew find themselves pitted against their desperate passengers – all while an ominous fog envelops the ship and everyone onboard.

programme.title: Ghost Blows The Lamp of the Longling Temple [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shirley Yang returns to China in search of professor Sun to rid herself of her erythema, only to find him trapped in the mysterious Long Ling cave.

programme.title: A LEGEND [English Dub]
programme.desc: An archeologist noticed that the texture of the relics discovered during the excavation of a glacier closely resembled a jade pendant seen in one of his dreams. He and his team then embark on an expedition into the depths of the glacier.

programme.title: High Forces [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Distanced from his family after a car accident takes the sight of his daughter, a father must use his professional bodyguard training when a flight they're on is overtaken by armed hijackers. A taut puzzle of deception unravels when the hijackers' motivations are revealed and the father must rescue not only his daughter and wife, but all those aboard.

programme.title: Yesterday Once More [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Gu Yuxuan and Han Shuyan almost had a fated encounter when they were children. After they grew up, the two met again as they are destined to fall in love. After experiencing the happiness and sweetness of love, they had to face the test of fate together. Can the miracle of love keep them together?

programme.title: The 12th Suspect [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In this acclaimed whodunnit thriller, a bohemian teahouse becomes an interrogation room when the murder of a prominent poet brings a zealous detective to investigate--and he's marked every single customer as a potential suspect.

programme.title: EYE FOR AN EYE: THE BLIND SWORDSMAN [English Dub]
programme.desc: The story focuses on Visually impaired but nonetheless lethal bounty hunter Cheng Xiazi who happened upon the assaulted Ni Yan, the lone survivor of a brutal massacre that claimed her whole family.

programme.title: EYE FOR AN EYE 2: BLIND VENGEANCE [English Dub]
programme.desc: A blind swordsman reluctantly mentors an orphan seeking vengeance for his destroyed family, teaching him martial arts skills. The orphan waits for an opportunity to avenge his kin.

programme.title: Firefighters [English Dub]
programme.desc: Even in the harshest environments, firefighters must focus on extinguishing fires and rescuing everyone there. At 3:47 AM on March 4, 2001, the 119 emergency call center receives a phone call about a fire that has broken out in the Hongje-dong neighborhood. Firefighters, including newcomer Cheol-woong, rush to the scene.

programme.title: Oh Lucy! [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Bored Tokyo lady Setsuko (Independent Spirit Award-nominee Shinobu Terajima) breaks free of her monotonous life when her niece, Mika (Shioli Kutsuna) convinces her to enroll in an unorthodox English class. There, she adopts a blonde-haired alter ego name 'Lucy' and develops romantic feelings for her American instructor, John (Josh Hartnett).But after his sudden disappearance, Setsuko follows his trail halfway around the world to Southern California, where family ties and past lives are tested as she struggles to fulfill the promise of 'Lucy.'

programme.title: Recalled [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Soo-jin, a woman suffering from post-traumatic memory loss, returns to her daily life with her loving husband. But her recovery takes an unexpected turn when she starts experiencing eerie visions: A child living being hit by a car, then a girl being harassed by a man. She runs into her former boss and learns that her husband may not be telling the truth about everything.

programme.title: Love, Again [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Hyun Woo is finally living freely after his divorce—whether by choice or not. When circumstances force him to confront his ex-wife, he’s determined to steer clear, afraid of slipping back into the misery of their married life. However, the news that she’s dating someone new unsettles him even more—especially when he discovers her boyfriend is his longtime high school rival.

programme.title: ESCAPE FROM MOGADISHU [English Dub]
programme.desc: Diplomats from the North and South Korean embassies in Somalia attempt a daring joint escape from Mogadishu when the outbreak of civil war leaves them stranded.

programme.title: The Big Swindle [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Five best swindlers in Korea form a team to rob Korea Bank, the biggest and most difficult bank to rob. Even as they work together for their common goal, each swindler has a secret agenda and does not trust others. After the bank is robbed, the police learn that the anonymous caller who helped them catch some members is a girlfriend of one of the swindlers and that she might be holding the key to solving the mysterious disappearance of money.

programme.title: PANDA PLAN [English Dub]
programme.desc: International action superstar Jackie Chan is involved in a rescue operation of a beloved zoo panda named Hu Hu.

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: There is an iron rule in the Ching Hing Gang: No drug dealing. The gang leader, Yu Nam, has two right-hand men. One chooses to live in the bright world, while one is in the black. 15 yeas later, what will happen when they reunion?

programme.title: Glass Garden [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Jae-yeon's leg hasn't grown since she was twelve. She is a bioscientist researching on artificial blood based on a chloroplast. She believes that the chloroplast will help the recovery of one's physical body. At the conference, her assertion is considered as purely theoretical, while Soo-hee, her co-worker who stole her idea, gets good reviews. Moreover, Prof. Jung, Jae-yeon's lover, is having an affair with Soo-hee. That's why she isolated herself in the woods where she grew up. Meanwhile, Ji-hoon is an unknown novelist who has a hard time. His girlfriend broke up with him, and his career is in danger after his disrespectful behavior at a social gathering. He finds writing on the wall, saying, ''I was born from a tree.'' He asks around about the previous tenant and finds Jae-yeon in the woods. He starts observing her life and write what he sees as a novel.

programme.title: The Suspect [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Dong-chul seeks truth after family's murder. Framed for boss's death, he'll start a war for answers.

programme.title: BROTHERHOOD OF BLADES [English Dub]
programme.desc: In the late Ming Dynasty, three sworn brothers who serve as the imperial secret police are dispatched to hunt down Wei Zhongxian, a eunuch politician who had been forced to resign from his influential post and exiled from Beijing. The brothers return successfully from their quest, only to find that their task was but the beginning of a strange conspiracy.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Dork Hunters and The Pirates of Tortuga Island
programme.desc: The Dork Hunters visit tropical Tortuga Island on their summer vacation, unaware that the Dork Commander and his second-in-command are at the same resort in search of a buried treasure chest full of micro-galaxies

programme.title: Highlander: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A flashback shows the death of Connor MacLeod at Kortan's hand during the Jettator ceremony.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Tentacle 8
programme.desc: A mysterious computer virus wipes out highly classified personnel files at the NSA, prompting a top secret investigation. Raymond Berry, an NSA operative suspected of crimes against the United States, risks his life to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Susie's Hope
programme.desc: Based on a true story, the inspirational relationship between Donna Lawrence (Emmanuelle Vaguer) a pit bull attack survivor, and Susie (Susie Lawrence), an abused pit bull-mix puppy, as they learn to heal and forgive together.

programme.title: Like Sunday, Like Rain
programme.desc: Surrounded by wealth and living with abundant resources in Manhattan, 12-year-old cello prodigy Reggie, lives a solitary life lacking only frequently absent parents and friends. Estranged from family, having slacker boyfriend troubles, and fired from her waitressing job, sometimes musician 23-year-old Eleanor needs a new place to live and a new job.

programme.title: Watercolor Postcards
programme.desc: A small town girl with a troubled past returns home only to find that both her sister and her hometown are in peril. Only when she falls for a man who similarly has dark days behind him will they muster up the faith and love needed to save the things they hold dear in life.

programme.title: Camp Cool Kids
programme.desc: At their summer camp competition games, Spence and his big brother Zach find themselves on opposing teams: its the dweebs against the bullies. Can Spence make new friends, overcome his fears and find faith in himself, stand up to the bullies and win a trophy in the process?

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: A miracle happens when you stop thinking with fear and start thinking with love. Your greatest power lies in your mind. To establish stronger connections, you need to go into every situation requesting to be an instrument of love. When you approach your interactions with love, you'll begin to have more miraculous relationships.

programme.title: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: Day one explores core teachings from A Course in Miracles: releasing ambition, ego, and grandiosity to become a compassionate presence. Rather than fixing or leading, we learn to hold space, trust divine guidance, and allow true healing and spiritual transmission to unfold.

programme.title: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: Day 2 of Teaching the Teachers explores the core teaching that only love is real and fear is illusion. Not a religion, the Course offers a non-dogmatic spiritual path that can complement other teachings and invites surrender to a higher power for true healing.

programme.title: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: Day Three of Teaching the Teachers reveals that the ego conceals our perfect, God-created Self. We are not our bodies, and life continues beyond birth and death. Thoughts create effects, yet through atonement we can be freed from guilt, fear, and suffering when we choose healing.

programme.title: A Life Reset
programme.desc: Habits, intuition, and longevity. Dave Asprey and Garry explore what it really takes to build a life that lasts.

programme.title: A Life Reset

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: The team, led by Anand, prepare for their motorcycle adventure to the four sacred peaks. The first practice ride is here in the birthplace of yoga, but it is not encouraging as monsoons are destroying roads and villages, Fred seems a liability and Ryan's seizures could be an issue.

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Jen and Jeff’s dream is to save their marriage on this journey, but it’s clear they are in different mindsets from the beginning. We are reminded that Anand himself had a prophecy of death and his teachers and life adventures helped guide him to freedom. Heading towards Kedarnath, night’s darkness sets in and Ryan sees someone Flip over their handlebars…

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Our first glimpse of the first peak, Kedarnath, the temple of death. Anand reminds us that What needs to die is part of the ego, fears, and comforts. Ken thinks people are riding recklessly, Mario takes his first spill, injuring his passenger Aizhan. Jeff ‘s comments further alienate Jen, but motivate her to rise up to greatness…

programme.title: Rooted In Wellness
programme.desc: In our very first solo episode of Rooted in Wellness, we explore the transformative power of being anchored like a sturdy tree—steady, grounded, and unwavering amidst life's storms. We'll illuminate how feeling rooted manifests as inner peace, emotional stability, and a profound connection with yourself and the world around you.

programme.title: Rooted In Wellness
programme.desc: Have you ever felt like your hormones are playing a tune out of sync with your well-being? Chances are, they probably are. The good news? There's a transformative journey waiting for women when they realign with nature, pay attention to their meals, and practice intermittent fasting the right way.

programme.title: Rooted In Wellness
programme.desc: Did you know that your metabolic health and energy are controlled by our modern food? This means your metabolism is not broken! You just need to work on healing your metabolism through simple lifestyle shifts you can easily apply to your life today.How? This is what we dive into in this episode of Rooted in Wellness with Casey Means.

programme.title: Millionaire Maker
programme.desc: Shawn Meaike's Millionaire Maker is a new series that shows you what you're really worth. Shawn is confident he could pluck anyone - no matter their background or experience - and turn them into a 7-figure earner...IF, they have the right attitude and drive. This series is about Shawn selecting who he will mentor and teach to reach a level of success they never thought possible. Welcome to the toughest job interview of your life. In this episode, Shawn meets the contestants and immediately finds out who's actually willing to fight for the life they want.

programme.title: Millionaire Maker
programme.desc: Shawn only wants folks who are willing to be honest about their struggles because it shows you can be fearless. Everyone deserves a happy life...but he can only help you if you're ready to take a chance on yourself. In this episode, the candidates have to sell themselves. They have to tell Shawn their story because he wants to know how you got stuck...but more importantly, they have to convince him they won’t give up...no matter how hard it is to hang on, or take a leap of faith.

programme.title: Millionaire Maker
programme.desc: If you had a chance to close Shawn, could you get it done? Today's the day we see who has the goods. Each team has one goal. Get the contract signed. Shawn is not going to make it easy, but often your audience isn't the hardest part. Sometimes getting out of your own way is the biggest challenge. Prepare to witness a pitch fest for the ages. You'll see that it doesn't matter what you're selling - a Yacht, a Ferrari, a Private Jet...or a Potato - if you don't connect with Shawn, you have no chance.

programme.title: Millionaire Maker
programme.desc: This is it. A winner will be chosen. The decision is FINAL...But we still have a crowd of candidates that each think they will be the one. Now comes a test of mental toughness. It's all come down to these final moments. Who can convince Shawn that they won't give up when things get...painful. What would you endure for a chance at greatness?...Watch the season finale of Shawn Meaike's Millionaire Maker.

In this video, I show you three different ways to treat the wood surface so that even WITH a water-based topcoat, the wood looks more like an oil-based finish.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri sintiéndose víctima de los efectos del alcohol le confiesa a Juan Diego sus sentimientos por el ganándose así el interés del muchacho quien se muestra sorprendido debido a su inocente confesión. En el centro comercial Solimar se reúne con Wilker informando a este sobre su preocupación por Yubiri desde que su mejor amiga se aparto de ella al saberla relacionada sentimentalmente. Olegario intenta disimular su antipatía por Mauricio.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Sus compañeros envidian a Luis Fernando. María Antonia reprocha a Paco que intente robarle. Eglee se disgusta al saber que Luis Fernando ya no se interpondrá en su relación con Santiago. Yesenia declara su amor a Marco Aurelio.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo enfrenta el acoso de Celia, quien le oculta su embarazo, mientras Manuela investiga a Misael. Moisés busca a su padre con apoyo de Elizabeth. Entre tensiones familiares y secretos, Ricardo teme perder a Manuela tras la llegada de Graciela. Benjamín sabotea a Rebeca y Verónica intenta seducir a Marcelo sin éxito. La Nonna se enfrenta a Katiuska para proteger la relación de su nieto, mientras los conflictos por el pasado y las herencias amenazan la estabilidad de todos.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: José Luis llega golpeado a la residencia y acusa a Erasto. Blanca, al oírlo, expulsa a Natalia al confirmarla como amante de Erasto. Arminda y Eustoquio aterrorizan a Erasto disfrazándose de Benedicto para enloquecerlo. Isaías confiesa en voz alta su alcoholismo en la sesión. Salvador confiesa a Adolfo que siempre supo de la hija perdida. Alejandro se desahoga con Gualberto, quien le aconseja dejar a Rosalía. Junior incita a Rosalía y ella jura hacer algo que impedirá que Alejandro la deje, gestando lo que será su gran mentira.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Oriana le revela a Alejandra su amorío con Rodrigo. Esta última trata de disimular su molestia pero finalmente confronta a Rodrigo y lo echa de su casa. Julio escucha por casualidad la conversación entre Virginia y Carlos Ernesto sobre la identidad de uno de los hermanos mayores y le exige a su tío que le revele cuál de los dos hermanos no es un Ferrándiz. Trinidad finalmente encuentra a Irene en casa de Felipe y la insta a volver a su casa. Paula trata de que Felipe desista de su plan con Irene pero él termina por anunciarle que su romance terminó y que está dispuesto a esperar a Irene el tiempo que sea. Maribel y Virginia, por distintos lados, ven a Leonardo besarse con Rebeca y deciden ir a contárselo a Irene.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Heriberto y Alejandro arman una gresca hasta que aparece Sol con una escopeta y los separa. Heriberto le pide a Sol que no lo vuelva a dejar en ridículo delante de nadie y le pregunta cuando será suya. El doctor viene a ver a Heriberto y le da la noticia de que su disfunción eréctil puede revertirse. Heriberto piensa que va a sorprender a Sol. Esperancita le dice a Alejandro que sus padres no duermen juntos y Alejandro aprovecha para preguntarle a Sol si ella y Heriberto tienen relaciones.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Carlos Ernesto sigue aferrado a su plan para desenmascarar a Rebeca y vuelve a reclutar la ayuda de Juan Pablo, quien accede a darle tres días para resolverlo. Maribel y Virginia le revelan a Irene que vieron a Leonardo besar a Rebeca y ella aprovecha el momento para comunicarle a su hermana que va a ser tía. Trinidad confronta a Virginia para preguntarle sobre la verdadera identidad del padre de María Lucía. Virginia finalmente le confiesa que María Lucía es producto de una violación. Irene llama a la casa para pedirle a Coromoto que junte sus cosas. Rebeca urde un plan para seducir a Leonardo y hacer el amor con él. Leonardo primero la rechaza.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol sigue adelante con su plan de hacer justicia con Reina y la tiene cada vez más acorralada. Piensa ponerle otra demanda por haber abandonado a su hija Cristina. También la va a obligar a retirar la demanda de Reina sobre Rika a cambio de no demandarla por causa de un dudoso contrato con Aída.Eloy, ya en su nueva oficina, no sabe cómo sacarse de encima a su antigua amante Cristina. Alicia va a lo de Maricielo y le cuenta la terrible noticia de que son hermanas.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Bienvenida conversa con Yubiri al saberla afectada por la relación existente entre Solimar y Wilker descubriendo en su hija un sentimiento de amor capaz de intervenir en la relación de su mejor amiga con el muchacho | Bienvenida aconseja a Yubiri para que esta no se deje enloquecer por su sentimiento y acepte acercarse nuevamente a su amistad con Solimar al relatarle la cruel verdad sobre la transitoriedad de la presencia de los hombres en la vida de las mujeres.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Dileidy le dice a Santiago que Luis Fernando no se opondrá a su relación con Eglee. Santiago siente el rechazo de Eglee. Matilde y Pasquita tienen un fuerte enfrentamiento. Luis Fernando le pide a María Gracia que se separen.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: La Nonna se enfrenta a Katiuska por intentar separar a Ricardo y Manuela. Mientras Verónica seduce a Marcelo, Celia oculta su pasado y Elizabeth revela su nuevo embarazo, lo que amenaza el matrimonio de su padre. Katiuska sigue intrigando contra la pareja, manipulando pruebas y sembrando dudas sobre la amistad de Manuela con Misael, quien confiesa su amor por ella. Ricardo descubre que Misael y Donatella están casados, mientras Graciela busca soluciones para la infertilidad de Manuela.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Maricela pide a Alberto que le consiga un certificado de embarazo falso. Erasto humilla a Natalia llevándola a su propia casa frente a Arminda. Blanca llega a casa de Erasto a confrontarlo, acusándolo de querer matarla para casarse con Natalia. Alejandro intenta romper con Rosalía, pero ella le muestra el certificado de embarazo falso, paralizando su decisión. Adolfo promete a Consuelo seguir buscando a su hija. Rosa cuenta a Carmen el pasado de Consuelo y su hija perdida; Carmen se desmaya conmocionada al oír la historia que toca demasiado de cerca su propia herida secreta.

programme.desc: Bienvenida conversa con Yubiri al saberla afectada por la relación existente entre Solimar y Wilker descubriendo en su hija un sentimiento de amor capaz de intervenir en la relación de su mejor amiga con el muchacho | Bienvenida aconseja a Yubiri para que esta no se deje enloquecer por su sentimiento y acepte acercarse nuevamente a su amistad con Solimar al relatarle la cruel verdad sobre la transitoriedad de la presencia de los hombres en la vida de las mujeres.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Dileidy le dice a Santiago que Luis Fernando no se opondrá a su relación con Eglee. Santiago siente el rechazo de Eglee. Matilde y Pasquita tienen un fuerte enfrentamiento. Luis Fernando le pide a María Gracia que se separen.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: La Nonna se enfrenta a Katiuska por intentar separar a Ricardo y Manuela. Mientras Verónica seduce a Marcelo, Celia oculta su pasado y Elizabeth revela su nuevo embarazo, lo que amenaza el matrimonio de su padre. Katiuska sigue intrigando contra la pareja, manipulando pruebas y sembrando dudas sobre la amistad de Manuela con Misael, quien confiesa su amor por ella. Ricardo descubre que Misael y Donatella están casados, mientras Graciela busca soluciones para la infertilidad de Manuela.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Maricela pide a Alberto que le consiga un certificado de embarazo falso. Erasto humilla a Natalia llevándola a su propia casa frente a Arminda. Blanca llega a casa de Erasto a confrontarlo, acusándolo de querer matarla para casarse con Natalia. Alejandro intenta romper con Rosalía, pero ella le muestra el certificado de embarazo falso, paralizando su decisión. Adolfo promete a Consuelo seguir buscando a su hija. Rosa cuenta a Carmen el pasado de Consuelo y su hija perdida; Carmen se desmaya conmocionada al oír la historia que toca demasiado de cerca su propia herida secreta.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Carlos Ernesto sigue aferrado a su plan para desenmascarar a Rebeca y vuelve a reclutar la ayuda de Juan Pablo, quien accede a darle tres días para resolverlo. Maribel y Virginia le revelan a Irene que vieron a Leonardo besar a Rebeca y ella aprovecha el momento para comunicarle a su hermana que va a ser tía. Trinidad confronta a Virginia para preguntarle sobre la verdadera identidad del padre de María Lucía. Virginia finalmente le confiesa que María Lucía es producto de una violación. Irene llama a la casa para pedirle a Coromoto que junte sus cosas. Rebeca urde un plan para seducir a Leonardo y hacer el amor con él. Leonardo primero la rechaza.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol sigue adelante con su plan de hacer justicia con Reina y la tiene cada vez más acorralada. Piensa ponerle otra demanda por haber abandonado a su hija Cristina. También la va a obligar a retirar la demanda de Reina sobre Rika a cambio de no demandarla por causa de un dudoso contrato con Aída.Eloy, ya en su nueva oficina, no sabe cómo sacarse de encima a su antigua amante Cristina. Alicia va a lo de Maricielo y le cuenta la terrible noticia de que son hermanas.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo y Rebeca amanecen juntos y son sorprendidos por Coromoto y el personal doméstico. A continuación, Rebeca "abre" la situación ante todos e invita a los niños a pasar al cuarto a saludar a su padre. María Lucía se entera de que un benefactor misterioso pagó todas las cuotas de su colegiatura. Luego, al toparse con Julio en los pasillos de la universidad, él le confiesa que fue él. Irene recibe la visita de Paula en casa de Felipe y tienen una discusión tensa. Paula luego va a ver a Felipe al estudio y tergiversa los términos de la conversación. Felipe le pide que se vaya y los deje en paz. La investigación de Carlos Ernesto progresa gracias al esfuerzo de Juan Pablo, quien ha descubierto un extraño movimiento de los bienes de Rebeca mientras ella estaba supuestamente muerta.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro escucha a Sol diciéndole a Heriberto por teléfono que ella nunca fue ni será suya. Alejandro le pregunta sobre esto, por Sol niega todo. Sol le pide a Aída que le extraiga sin saber a Alejandro una muestra de ADN para hacerle la prueba de paternidad. Aída le cuenta de esto a Alejandroy él se ofrece a hacer la prueba sin resistirse. La que se opone es Aída, y no quiere dar explicaciones, pero Sol le pone en evidencia preguntándole por qué le transfirió toda su fortuna a Reina.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Esta es la historia de amor de una mujer fuerte; Serafima, quien está en un triángulo amoroso. Durante veinte años, su rival y ella han amado al mismo hombre. Además de melodrama, también muestra la vida cotidiana. Un relato sobre la historia de Rusia a través de los ojos de una persona. El destino de Serafima refleja la historia de todo el país: desde la época soviética, la perestroika, hasta la época actual.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima queda embarazada de Víctor. Tras una pelea, él es herido y ella lo cuida. Irina, la chica que Víctor ama, descubre la verdad y lo deja. Víctor y Sima se casan, pero él solo espera el nacimiento del bebé.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: El hijo de Sima nace con una grave enfermedad del corazón. Víctor la culpa. Sima busca ayuda médica en Moscú y conoce a una periodista que duda que un cirujano famoso la opere.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Irina y Víctor retoman su romance. Sima acude al cirujano Krasin por su hijo y termina salvándolo de un atentado. Agradecido, Krasin acepta operar al niño.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima permite que Irina y Víctor se vean los fines de semana. Empieza a construir su casa, mientras Irina se involucra con un gánster. Un grupo de delincuentes incendia los establos de Sima.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima pierde a su bebé y queda estéril. Irina queda embarazada de otro hombre pero miente diciendo que es de Víctor. Sima le propone divorcio a Víctor y cae en una profunda depresión.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima convence a Irina de darle el bebé a cambio de dinero. Irina se marcha, mientras Víctor planea estudiar veterinaria. Irina, en caída libre, recurre a la brujería para vengarse de Víctor, quien es diagnosticado con leucemia.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Sima vende sus caballos para pagar la cirugía de Víctor en Alemania. Un adicto roba el dinero y lo entrega a un traficante. Víctor huye del hospital en busca del ladrón.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Víctor muere e Irina culpa a Sima. Irina intenta llevarse a su hija, pero Sima sigue adelante con la ayuda de la niña y de su ahijada. Vania, el hijo de Sima, regresa del ejército y se enamora de una empleada de Irina.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Vania le propone matrimonio a Larisa, pero Sima no la aprueba. Irina manipula a Vania para que reclame su parte de la granja. Sima conoce a un editor llamado Andréi en un viaje.

programme.title: Serafima la bella

programme.title: Om Nom Stories
